Pages hold block markup; <!-- wp:pattern {"slug":"..."} /--> is expanded into the pattern's blocks on import. "{{theme}}" stands for the theme folder URL. "screens" lists the URL of each catalogue page. "productCategories", "productTags" and "products" are imported by inc/woo-import.php, only while WooCommerce is active; each product's "Measurements" attribute is the single source of the lens-bridge-temple line shown on cards and product pages. The atelier address, hours and fitting appointments, and the fallback frame directory, are not in this file: they live in synced patterns (inc/shared-info.php, inc/info/*.html) that every page references.

posts.title: Drawing a frame at full scale
posts.excerpt: Every Kumo frame starts as a pencil line on gridded paper, one to one. Aki on why we never draw smaller.
posts.content:
Every Kumo frame starts as a pencil line on gridded paper, one to one. Aki on why we never draw smaller.

At the bench

A frame is a set of small agreements: the hinge with the temple, the pad with the nose, the rim with the lens. Each is measured, then checked by hand against the drawing.

Nothing is rushed. A titanium rim is bent cold in three passes and soldered once; the joint is polished until a fingernail cannot find it.

On the face

What you notice is not the work but its absence: a frame that sits level, weighs almost nothing and stays where it was set.

A good frame is one you forget you are wearing.

Yui Kanzaki
